name: Kepler Track
why: A loop from Lake Te Anau up to a long open ridge under Mount Luxmore, then down the Iris Burn to Lake Manapouri.
book: Great Walk: Luxmore, Iris Burn and Moturau huts and Brod Bay and Iris Burn campsites must be booked for 27 Oct-30 Apr. The car park by the control gates is 5 km from Te Anau; shuttles also stop at Rainbow Reach.
water: Fill up at Luxmore Hut: no reliable water on the alpine section until Iris Burn Hut.
dangers: The ridge between Luxmore and Iris Burn huts is above the bushline for hours, exposed to wind, cloud and snow.
Steep climb under limestone bluffs from Brod Bay to the bushline.
Avalanche terrain on the tops outside the summer season.
turnaround: If it is windy or in cloud at Luxmore Hut, do not set out along the ridge: wait or walk back to the car park.

points.name: Kepler Track car park, control gates
points.note: At the Waiau River control gates, 5 km from Te Anau. Lakeside beech forest to Brod Bay.

points.name: Luxmore Hut
points.note: First night, above the bushline with views over Lake Te Anau. Luxmore Cave is 20 min return.

points.name: Mount Luxmore ridge
points.note: Turn-off for the 30 min return to the 1,472 m summit, the highest point of the track.

points.name: Iris Burn Hut
points.note: Second night, in a tussock clearing after the long zigzag descent from the ridge.

points.name: Moturau Hut
points.note: Third night on the beach of Lake Manapouri, after 16.2 km down the Iris Burn.

points.name: Rainbow Reach
points.note: Swing bridge over the Waiau River and a shuttle stop; the loop goes on 9.5 km along the river to the car park.
